acts.subject: Orazio Mazza

acts.subject: Rosaria Mazza

acts.subject: Venerio Mazza

acts.subject: Gaetano Mazza
acts.note: Read in full. Witnesses Dimauro Salvatore 22 and Zappalà Sebastiano 24, both braccianti.

acts.subject: Salvatore Mazza & Concetta Sciacca
acts.note: Read in full. THE KEY ACT. Salvatore, 34, bracciante, born and resident Piedimonte Etneo, son of Innocenzio and of Domenica Cavallaro — the father's name written in the contracted form «Senzio». Concetta Sciacca, 19, contadina, daughter of the late Antonino Sciacca and Rosaria Greco.

acts.subject: Antonino Mazza & Rosa Raiti
acts.note: Read in full. Antonino Mazza, 31, bracciante, born and resident Piedimonte Etneo, «figlio d'Innocenzio, bracciante, e di Domenica Cavallaro, industriosa». Rosa Raiti, 20, industriosa, daughter of Giuseppe Raiti, bracciante, and Agata Pennisi. Witnesses Angelo Russo fu Venero, 40, and Felice Russo fu Angelo, 60. THIS IS THE ACT THAT SPELLS THE FATHER'S NAME IN FULL and makes Salvatore and Antonino brothers.

acts.subject: Maria Nicotra
acts.note: NOT OURS, AND THE MARGIN IS WHAT PROVES IT. The annual index gives exactly one Nicotra Maria in 1875 and this is she. Her marginal annotation reads «Unita in matrimonio con NICITO GIUSEPPE fu Vincenzo con atto del 29.7.91 iscritto in Piedimonte Etneo» -- she married in 1891 and stayed. Ours married SALVATORE MAZZA and died at Brisbane in 1963. So 1875 is eliminated for Maria Concetta Nicotra, and the margin annotation is the test to apply to every other candidate year.

acts.subject: Mariano Mazza
acts.note: Read in full. Rosario is TWENTY-SEVEN in February 1872, so born about 1845 -- a third independent confirmation of the 1845 birth act against the tree's 1850, after the act itself and the death act of 1924. Both parents are given with their patronymics, «di Mariano» and «di Gaetano», which is how this register writes a living father.

acts.subject: Orazio Mazza
acts.note: NOT OUR HOUSEHOLD, AND THIS IS THE NAMESAKE TRAP AT ITS WORST. A Rosario Mazza whose wife is ALSO a Leonarda -- but LEONARDA MONACORSO, not Leonarda Bonanno -- living in VIA GROTTA NICODEMO, not contrada San Basilio, and given no patronymic where ours is always «di Mariano». The tree's Orazio Mazza is born 1883 to Rosario and Leonarda, so this act is exactly the kind of thing that gets attached to the wrong man. It is not him. TWO MARRIAGES IN THE MARGIN: «unito in matrimonio con CURCURUTO ROSA di Leonardo con atto del 26 Genn.o 905 iscritto in Linguaglossa», and a later stamped ANNOTAZIONE, «ha contratto matrimonio con MANGANO MARIA in Fiumefreddo giusta atto 22-2-1927».
